outcome: One bounded X7R screening candidate is documented. Four single-input substitutions retain the effective-input floor in arithmetic. Two 10 uF 0603 output replacements are rejected after AC-amplitude sensitivity. No part is qualified by typical curves.

summary.interpretation: Area sum is only an optimistic lower-bound screen; does NOT prove packing, escape, routing, local decoupling, thermal feasibility or assembly compatibility. DNP/test point land reservations still consume area. Unknown component choices can grow. Edge band is an explicit provisional assumption, not recovered original geometry.

temperature_context.warning: 125 C is a component temperature ceiling. Self-heating and heat conducted from nearby components must be measured; 40 C arithmetic difference from 85 C air is not established thermal margin. Manufacturer voltage/temperature derating still applies.

CL31B226KPHNNNE.courtyard_status: Assembly-planning scenario only. Clearances are explicit assumptions, not manufacturer minimum courtyards.

CL10B106MQ8NRNC.courtyard_status: Assembly-planning scenario only. Clearances are explicit assumptions, not manufacturer minimum courtyards.

TPS6282xA.table_caveat: At 0.47 uH, 2 x 10 or 22 uF nominal is a standard combination. Combined screen factors can fall outside the table footnote anticipated -35% range; validate the actual application.

TPS62864.input_wording: For most applications, 8 uF is sufficient effective input capacitance. Retained as the project floor.
TPS62864.table_caveat: 3 x 22 uF is listed at 0.24 uH. Four 22 uF, seven 10 uF, or other intermediate totals are not exact tested rows. Actual capacitance, loop stability and transient behavior require qualification.

TI_requirements.exact_0603_part_also_listed: CL10B106MQ8NRNC appears in TPS62864 table 9-2 as an input capacitor; this does not qualify it as the proposed output bank.

factor_interpretation.initial_tolerance: Manufacturer stated +/-10% for 22 uF and +/-20% for 10 uF.
factor_interpretation.temperature_reason: Separate official bias-temperature curves have minimum relative-to-25 C ratios 0.8272 at 5 V for 22 uF and 0.8126 at 3.15 V for 10 uF, so a plain 0.85 temperature factor does not cover those samples. Chosen 0.80 is a screen, not a proven bound at every application voltage.
factor_interpretation.AC_reason: Apply rounded-down factors 0.83 and 0.79 based on minima of separate official zero-DC-bias AC-amplitude curves. Multiplication with DC and temperature curves is an illustrative sensitivity, not a validated joint model.
factor_interpretation.aging_and_model_qualification: Neither 10% allowance is a manufacturer lifetime or lot guarantee. Lifetime is unspecified.
factor_interpretation.low_signal_and_frequency_limit: Bias and AC curves use 120 Hz or 1 kHz measurement stimuli, not demonstrated installed switching ripple. Behavior below the published AC range and simultaneous bias, temperature and ripple remains open.

coherent_candidate.added_positions_if_approved: Three additional capacitors in parallel with the C228 output position; no reference numbers assigned or CAD edited.

bounds: The main 253-reference snapshot is used. The separate high-temperature 254-reference variant is not rebased here.
The 1.675 V CPU/KPU check is the converter programmable endpoint for capacitor stress only, not an approved K230 voltage.
Fixed-output +5% voltages are illustrative, not an established combined tolerance and transient budget.
Single inputs need ripple-current, input-transient and hot-loop-layout checks; satisfying the capacitance floor is necessary but insufficient.
No required effective capacitance was dropped and no master, BOM or geometry was edited.
Other capacitors, including local-bulk placeholders, retain optimistic baseline reservations in full-board sensitivity totals. Required bulk, routing, escape and thermal space remain unresolved.
Manufacturer land dimensions are exact recommendations; added courtyard clearances are planning assumptions. Copper-pad area, land-envelope area and courtyard area are distinct.
These exact parts do not prove that smaller qualified alternatives cannot exist.
No routed fit, assembly release, voltage-temperature qualification or lifetime guarantee is established.
